Commentary.Commentary: The rise of the Asian minnows has coincided with the fall of one of the Asian giants. Bangladesh continue to take giant steps and their transformation from cubs to tigers has been very impressive. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are going from bad to worse with every performance and are in some sort of crisis. Something needs to be done before the Lankan Lions become an endangered species. That's all from this game. Do join us on Sunday for the 4th ODI of this tri-nation series involving Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka (once again). The action will begin at 1200 local (0600 GMT). Cheers!

The Man of the Match Award winner Shakib Al Hassan walks in for a chat. He credits all the batsmen for performing as a unit. Feels that Rahim's knock was very vital and praises Tamim for his innings. Adds that they need to keep improving and cannot afford to relax. Hopes that they continue to play in this manner and do all the things right. Also says that they will have to play three games in the space of five days, so they need to get everything right.

The Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza comes in next. He is delighted with the win and says that they have played well in recent times and need to keep going. He adds that there is something to learn from each game. Feels that Tamim should have got a hundred and praises Rahim for his knock. On their bowling performance, Mashrafe replies that they struggled in South Africa but now they are back home and are bowling well. Admits that 320 looked tough but some good batting from Sabbir Rahman helped them. Further adds that Sabbir used to bat at number 3 for them but they felt the need for someone who can hit the ball as hard as him later in the innings. Emphasizes on the fact that they need the top five batsmen to play 40-45 overs like today to be in a good position.

First up, the Sri Lanka captain Dinesh Chandimal, comes for an interview. Says that he is disappointed with the loss. Admits that they have been going through a bad patch in ODIs in the recent past and they need to get back to winning ways. Credits Bangladesh for the way they played today. On being asked about the key players missing out and his frame of mind, he opines that it is really tough to pick the first team and repeats that they need to win a couple of games to get back on track. Continues saying that they will go back and think over their performance. Also feels that they still have a chance to enter the final and will have to win the next game.

It was a clinical performance by the Bangla Tigers. They showed intent in their batting and posted a big total on the board. Their batsmen showed maturity and never let the momentum slip. In total, they managed four consecutive 50-plus stands which in a way was the difference between the two sides. They were terrific in the field too with their skipper leading from the front. Shakib had an amazing outing and once again proved his value with an all-round show.

For chasing a target in excess of 300, you need partnerships. The fact that Sri Lanka's best stand was 41 speaks volumes. They never got their run chase going. The regular fall of wickets made it impossible for them to gather any momentum. Plenty of starts for their batsmen but none got converted into anything substantial. An abject surrender from the one-time world champions and they are just not improving. With every game, they are only going backwards and require a big turnaround to stand even a chance to qualify for the final.

Massive, massive win for Bangladesh! They overpowered Sri Lankan by a handsome margin to register their biggest victory in this format (by runs). An extraordinary effort by the Bangla boys as they once again proved that they are a force to reckon with, especially at home. The crowd is delighted in Mirpur, they have got their money's worth after watching such a dominating show by the home team.

OUT! That's it! BANGLADESH WIN BY 163 RUNS and register their biggest win in ODIs (in terms of runs). Hossain misses his yorker, it turns out to be a low full toss for Dananjaya, who looks to heave this away over the leg side. But he mistimes his shot and the ball flies straight down the ground. Shakib moves across to his left from mid off to complete the formalities.
Short ball on leg, Dananjaya pulls this away through mid-wicket but they don't run through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spun away from Pradeep, he tried to flirt with it but missed.
Pitched up, Pradeep defends this with soft hands.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dananjaya is not going to stick in there. Slogs sweeps this fuller ball but it falls safe. They pick up a run.
FOUR! Boundary to start with. Tossed up around off, Dananjaya heaves this over the mid off fielder and it goes on the bounce to the fence.
Fullish length ball outside off, the batsman makes a leave to end the over.
Drinks break with just one more wicket left. Hmmm... Nuwan Pradeep is the last batsman out in the middle.
OUT! Leg stump goes for a walk! A beautifully bowled yorker by Rubel Hossain. He spears it in, Lakmal is late in bringing his bat down and finds his furniture shattered. End is nigh for Sri Lanka.
Takes the pace off the delivery and serves a length ball on off, Lakmal flicks it to mid-wicket. The non-striker was outside the crease and hence the fielder has a shy at his end. Misses the stumps.
A length ball outside off, hit firmly to mid off.
Wide called for height! Rubel digs in a short ball around off, Suranga tries to hook but misses. A stifled appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire.
Full toss this time, on middle, it's pushed down to mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Lakmal goes hard at it but manages to hit it as far as the bowler is standing in his followthrough.
Rubel Hossain comes into the attack.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. One run added to the total.
Suranga Lakmal comes in next.

OUT! Needless shot. Especially when you already have got 20 runs in the over. One shot too many from Thisara but then this is how he bats. Shakib darts this full around off and Perera goes for another heave. But the ball this time goes from the outer half of the bat and flies to Mahmudullah who takes his 50th ODI catch at long off. Shakib has his third wicket.

SIX! Right then! Perera not afraid to play his shots. Another huge hit and another maximum. Tossed up around off and Perera hits this over mid-wicket for a biggie. 20 runs already in the over with two balls left.
FOUR! Misfield and another boundary. Pitched up this time on middle and leg, Perera forces it down to long off. The fielder there gets to the ball but it goes through his hands for a boundary.
SIX! Drags his length back again, Perera rocks back and powers it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Short ball in the line of the stumps and Perera hits this hard with a flat bat straight back over the bowler for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Another boundary in the over. And Dananjaya cutting loose. Tossed up again and a similar result. Dananjaya sweeps it to the deep square leg region this time for a boundary.
Dananjaya drives this through the covers.
FOUR! Much-needed for Sri Lanka. No spin from Hossain as he puts it on the legs of Dananjaya. He whips it away over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darts this full, Perera works it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Dananjaya pushes at it tamely and gets beaten. Maiden from Shakib, he can do nothing wrong!
Shortish and outside off, Dananjaya plays it late but finds the short third man fielder.
Flatter and on middle, pushed back towards the bowler.
Gets on the front foot and defends a full ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Flatter and on off, Thisara punches it to sweeper cover where the fielder makes a sliding stop. A couple taken.
Goes back and tries to punch it down to long off. But the short extra cover fielder intervenes with a dive to stop the ball. Great intent shown in the field by Bangladesh.
Presses on the front foot and forces it through covers for one.
Gets forward and helps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nasir Hossain comes in for his next spell.
No hat-trick for Shakib! He tosses this one in the air and lands it full around middle, Dananjaya defends it off his front foot to mid-wicket. What an over, two runs and a couple of wickets from it!
Akila Dananjaya walks in next to face the hat-trick ball. Mortaza has given Shakib a very attacking field. A slip, leg slip, short leg and short mid-wicket in place. Here we go...

OUT! Shakib is on a hat-trick! A nothing shot from Hasaranga. This is not the shot anybody would be proud of first up. He needed to stick in with Perera but now can only watch from the balcony. A tossed up ball outside off, Hasaranga goes for the slog sweep over the leg side. But the ball flies high off the top edge and the keeper calls for it before settling underneath it behind the wickets. A simple catch for Rahim and Bangladesh inch closer to victory.
Wanindu Hasaranga is in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Gunaratne has thrown his wicket away. Shakib drags his length back a bit, lands it outside off and Gunaratne cuts this straight to Saifuddin stationed there at backward point. He just extends his arms for an easy catch. No expression from Shakib, almost like he knew he was getting this wicket.
Fuller in length, on middle and leg, Perera nudges it fine down the leg for one.
Perera works it down the leg side.
Pitched up, Gunaratne got a leading edge to it. The ball fell safely near mid off and they picked up a run.
FOUR! Free gift for the new batsman. Short ball around leg, Thisara nudges it fine and fetches a boundary to get going. 9 runs and a wicket from the over.
Turns it off his hips to backward square leg for one.
FOUR! Short ball in line of the stumps and Gunaratne has a short jab to it. He gets a top edge and the ball flies over the keeper for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Asela drives but finds the cover fielder.
Thisara Perera strides in next.

OUT! Chandimal is run out, you cannot keep Shakib Al Hasan out of the game. He has produced a moment of magic on the field. To start with, it's a length ball which is driven towards mid off. Dinesh tries to take on Shakib as he attempts for a brisk single. The Bangladeshi star all-rounder comes up with a direct hit at the bowler's end as Chandimal stretches out to get inside the crease. Looks out the moment it hit the stumps but the umpire refers it upstairs. The replays roll in and it finds the Sri Lankan skipper short. The tourists are going nowhere in this chase. 215 more needed off 154 balls.
Direct hit at the bowler's end. Appeal for a run out against Dinesh Chandimal. It's referred upstairs. Looks out. Let's see...

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. A length ball cutting back into the batsman from around off. Chandimal fails to work it around and is hit on the back leg. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Mortaza looks at his keeper who suggests not to take the referral. Maybe, a shade high!
Short again, Gunaratne punches this for no run.
Shorter this time around off, Chandimal rocks back and punches it through mid off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Chandimal.
Tossed up in line of the stumps and Gunaratne sweeps this behind square for one.
Tossed up, Chandimal drives it through mid off to rotate strike.
Chandimal punches this ball through mid off to end the over.
Length ball around off, Gunaratne guides this to third man for another run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller delivery, Gunaratne plays it behind square to pick up two runs.
Chandimal guides this to third man for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Mohammad Saifuddin comes in to bowl.
Floated delivery, Chandimal works it off his pads on the leg side for one.
Drags his length back, Gunaratne punches it on the off side for another run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Straighter one, Gunaratne plays it back to the bowler.
Gunaratne cuts this to the point fielder.
Tossed up, Chandimal works it through mid on for a run.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over. Deliberately done by Gunaratne. There was a slip fielder and Gunaratne guides it in between the keeper and the slip fielder to the fence. Length ball around off and Gunaratne at the last moment opens the face of the bat. Well played.
Full again on the pads of Chandimal who helps it on its way to square leg for another run.
Pitched up on middle and leg, Chandimal worked it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Chandimal cuts this to the point fielder.
Chandimal tries to drive this but is beaten again.
Swing and a miss! Pitched up around off, swinging away from Chandimal who goes for the big shot but misses it.
Beaten! Flatter through the air, a touch short and landing on off, Gunaratne tries playing from the back foot but it spins away slightly to beat the bat. Excellent bowling.
Advances down the track and forces it to long off for a single.
Loopy around off, driven back to the bowler.
Hangs on the back foot to a flattish delivery and punches it back to the bowler. No timing.
Tossed up alright but it's too full outside off, Asela drills it through covers for one.
Flighted and on middle, flicked in the gap on the leg side for a run.
Gunaratne has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Asela Gunaratne walks in next.

OUT! Sri Lanka are pushed further on the back foot as they lose another wicket. Dickwella sees his stumps going for a toss. Length ball landing around off, almost like a fast off cutter and moving back in after pitching. It stays low as well as Dickwella tries to pull it. But he is beaten by the lack of bounce. The ball goes on to uproot the off stump. Big wicket for Bangladesh and they are pumped up. The crowd is getting behind them!
Pitched up, Chandimal drives this past covers for another run.
Dickwella plays this through mid on for a run.
Played towards mid-wicket by Dickwella.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated again, on the legs of Dickwella who flicks it away on the leg side for one.
Tossed up, in line of the stumps, Chandimal plays it through mid on to rotate strike.
Slower through the air this time, Chandimal gets to the pitch of the ball and works it on the leg side for a couple of runs.
SIX! Biggie! Good intent from Chandimal. Dances down the track to this full length ball and lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Turn for Shakib. Length on the leg of Chandimal who gets beaten on his defense. The ball has hit the leg of Chandimal but the impact is outside the leg stump.
Shakib Al Hassan to roll his arm now.
Fires this on the legs of Dickwella who works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball.
Yorker! Dickwella does well to keep it at bay.
Drags this a bit short, Chandimal punches it on the off side for another run.
Around off and pitched up, Dickwella guided it away to third man for a single.
Dickwella cuts this to the point fielder.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower ball, Chandimal defends this to the short cover fielder.
Comes back into Chandimal after pitching. He plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Fuller this time, Chandimal works it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Eight over on the run for Mortaza. And this is why he is given the responsibility. Extra bounce this time and just misses the outside edge of Chandimal who tries to drive this length ball.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Chandimal punches this ball past mid off to give his partner the strike.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Found the gap this time, didn't time it well enough to go for a boundary but they managed to pick up two. Fuller ball on leg and Chandimal flicks it away towards the deep square leg region.
Driven through the covers by Chandimal.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
The captain is off the mark. Full ball on the legs of Chandimal who helps it fine down the leg side for one.
Back of a length ball, Dickwella cuts it past point for a run.

That's drinks now. Bangladesh now have three wickets and are on top. Once again Sri Lanka are struggling due to the reckless approach of their batsmen. They need partnerships to get anywhere close to the target. Dinesh Chandimal has joined Niroshan Dickwella in the middle. 259 needed off 218 balls.

OUT! Kusal Mendis has to take the long walk back now! He was struggling with his hamstring and was not taking the quick singles. The asking rate probably got to him as he tried to up the ante and perished. Mortaza dishes out a slower length ball in the line of the stumps and Mendis mistimes his lofted shot. The ball hits him a little high on the bat, his one hand comes off the handle and it skies up towards the mid off region. Rubel comes under it and makes no mistake. Mahmudullah was also interested, coming in from mid on but the calling was good. Another flop show from Mendis comes to an end. That's 33 runs now in six innings for him and 12 innings without a score of fifty. Tough times for the promising young batsman.
Mendis works this to the mid on fielder.
Dickwella this time eases it past covers to rotate strike.
Pitched up ball, in line of the stumps and Mendis drives it past covers for a single.
Uppish short but no fielder at the cover-point region. They run through.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Dickwella guides this down to the third man fielder for another run.
Length ball around off, Mendis cuts it past the point fielder to rotate strike.
Back of a length ball, nips back in to Dickwella who punches it away on the off side for a single.
Around off, Dickwella tries to cut this but gets an bottom edge to it before it dies in front of the cover fielder.
Mustafizur Rahman comes in to bowl.
Length ball on the legs of Dickwella, he nudges it away to the fine leg fielder for one.
Short again, this time Mendis pulls this to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. Was in the air for sometime but well short of the fielder.
Short, but Mendis doesn't get hold of it. The ball goes to the short mid-wicket fielder.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Dickwella works this ball through mid on to give his partner the strike.
Pitches it up in line of the stumps and Dickwella milks this through mid-wicket to retain strike.
Short again around off and Mendis pulls this too. Just this time straight to the fielder  at deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings. Mendis in total control of the shot. Rubel drags his length back around off and Mendis pulls this away to the deep square region for a boundary.
Full again, Dickwella works it towards mid-wicket for another run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flicked away by Dickwella. On the pads, pitched up and he flicks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Powerplay 2 time! Four fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Almost chops this onto his stumps first up. Around off, Dickwella goes for the cut and gets a bottom edge to it. The ball misses the stumps and runs towards fine leg. He gets off the mark.
Niroshan Dickwella walks in next.

OUT! That's the second wicket and Bangladesh have got their man. It's a pitched up ball around off, from round the wicket, Tharanga dances down and looks to loft this over mid off but only manages to get the toe end of the bat. The ball goes straight towards the fielder and Mahmudullah stationed there cups it with ease. Another blow to Sri Lanka and now they have lost both their openers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! That's gone fine. Full ball on the pads of Tharanga and he helps it on its way to the fence. That came more from the inner half of the bat.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Hossain has no mercy! Bangs this short again. Mendis does well to evade it.
Mendis is going to change his helmet after his chin strap came off.
Nasty! Bangs this ball short on leg, Mendis goes for the pull but the ball has gone on to hit his helmet. He looks fine and no damage has been done.
Fuller ball, Tharanga works it towards the leg side for a single.
Tharanga flicks this off his pads.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Slower ball on the pads of Tharanga who flicks it away to deep square leg. A good chase from the fielder there but they manage to come back for the third run.
Mendis guides this ball towards third man for one.
Drags his length back, Tharanga pulls this to mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Fuller this time, Mendis flicks this off his pads square of the wicket on he leg side for a run.
Mendis gets a leading edge to this ball and it falls short of the bowler. Length ball in line of the stumps, Mendis is early into his shot.

Mendis doesn't look good. Looks like he has just pulled his muscle here. He is seen stretching and out comes the physio for assistance. Sri Lanka will need him to continue. The umpires are now having a word with him to make a decision, whether he will continue or go out. Mendis finally puts his helmet on and makes up his mind to continue. Good news for the Lankans!
Length ball in line of the stumps and Tharanga guides it to mid on and they pick up a quick single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Length ball on middle and leg, Tharanga's one hand comes off the grip and he mishits in the air towards long on. Tamim hares towards it from inside the ring and dives forward to catch it but just doesn't get to it. Good effort from him, but doesn't stop the batsmen from picking up two runs.
Tharanga plays this ball to the point fielder.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman gets up on his toes to play that one and bunts it down.
The batsman plays the square cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball around off, Tharanga fails to put bat on ball.
The batsman goes for the pull but misses it completely.
Bangs this short. Mendis pulls this away square of the wicket on the leg side to come back for the second run. Good over for Sri Lanka.
Fuller in length, Mendis flicks this away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Four leg byes. Kept low again. Length ball on the pads of Mendis who looks for the flick. He doesn't connect and the ball hits him low on the pads and runs away for a boundary.
Bangs this short again, Tharanga cuts it behind point for one.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Mendis tries to pull this ball away but misses.
Rubel Hossain will get his first spell.
FOUR! Good shot! Pitched up ball in line of the stumps and Tharanga strides forward to punch it down the ground for a boundary.
Fuller in length, Mendis hits this through mid-wicket for one.

Two leg byes. Not a lot of damage done. Fires this full on the legs of Mendis who looks to go for the big heavy. The ball hits the pads of Mendis and goes away to the fine leg region. They come back for a couple of leg byes.
Free Hit for Sri Lanka. Mortaza has overstepped...
No ball! Mortaza has crossed the line. Length ball around off, Tharanga cuts it past backward point for one.
Beaten! This has nothing to do with the pitch. Good ball around off, Tharanga looks to drive but misses.
The pitch is playing tricks here. This ball again has kept low. In line of the stumps and Mendis bends to keep it out off the inside edge. It rolls to square leg and they pick up a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Loops it up outside off, bunted back to the bowler. 5 runs off the over and a wicket from it.
FOUR! Easily done! Flatter and shorter outside off, Tharanga waits for it and at the last moment he opens the face of the bat to guide it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Slower one around middle and leg, nudged away towards mid on for one.
Kusal Mendis walks in next to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Hossain draws first blood! He is up and running! The ploy to start with spin has worked wonders for Bangladesh. Hossain from around the wicket tosses it up on the stumps, Kusal Perera dances down the track to slog it wildly across the line. Misses the line completely and the ball sneaks under his bat to hit the timber behind. Perfect start for the hosts. Perera showed dangerous form in the last game and Bangladesh will be relieved after getting him cheaply. Big blow to Sri Lanka.
Back of a length ball outside off, Tharanga tries to cut this but gets a bottom edge to it towards the keeper.
Outside off, a length ball, Upul is beaten trying to drive the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kept low once again, length ball around off, Tharanga goes for the drive but is beaten by the lack of bounce.

NOT OUT! Yes, it has pitched outside leg. Great use of the review from Tharanga. Back of a length ball around leg stump and it stays really low. Tharanga goes for the pull but gets beaten due to the low bounce and is hit on the pads. A strong appeal from the players and the umpire raises his finger. However, Upul challenges the decision. The Hawk Eye shows that the ball pitched outside leg and that is the end of the story. The experienced campaigner survives a scary moment.
Trouble early on! Tharanga has been adjudged LBW but he goes for the review. The body language of the Bangladesh players is confident. Has that pitched outside leg?
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl from the other end.
Darts this full again, Perera eases it to mid on.
Fuller this time, Upul eases this through mid on for a single to open his account.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Beaten! Kept low. Straighter one around off and Tharanga tries to play for the spin but misses it.
Sri Lanka are away! Starts off with a fuller one in line of the stumps, Perera plays it through mid-wicket for one.

We are back for the chase. Kusal Perera and Upul Tharanga to open the batting for Sri Lanka. Bangladesh begin with spin. Nasir Hossain to start off the proceedings with the ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
